english_text: I'll prove my worth and make my mark!
czech_text: Ukážu, co ve mně je, a zanechám stopu!

english_text: We've been hurt by our allies' countermeasures!
Ah, Scipio! You ain't no match for me!
Have you considered the profitable alternatives?

czech_text: Ušetřete si čas a vzdejte se!

english_text: I'll make it worth your while!
We haven't lost yet! Fight on!
You can run, but you can't hide!
And THAT is how it is done!
I thought there was a war on!
Cease fire! We are attacking our allies!
We are being attacked by Allies!
Are you ready for a challenge?
We won't speak of this again.
What are we waiting for, exactly?
We are firing on our allies!
The foe's base will soon fall to us!
Our allies' countermeasures have caught us!
I can't die yet! I've barely begun!
czech_text: Ještě nesmím zemřít! Sotva jsem začal!

english_text: Wouldn't you rather be rich than dead?
czech_text: Nechcete být raději bohatí než mrtví?

english_text: Our foes have lost their leader!
The Roman scum Sulla is fallen!
Beware! Our men are being attacked!
Stop! We're firing on allied troops!
Capture the enemy's base or wipe them out!
czech_text: Dobuďte jejich základnu, nebo je vyhlaďte!

english_text: Kill them off or buy them out!

czech_text: Držte se pohromadě, jdeme na ně!

english_text: How about a little extra incentive?
I'm not getting any younger here.
At last, a chance for a decent fight!
Our base is lost! It's over!
I've got the men and I've got the means.
Germanicus is just one more dead Roman!
czech_text: Germanicus je jen další mrtvý Říman!

english_text: Ha! Caesar himself fell to us!
Ah, good! Our troops deign to rejoin us!
czech_text: Á, výborně! Naši vojáci se ráčí vrátit!

english_text: Our countermeasures have caught our allies!
The foe's base fell to us!
Ha! The enemy base is ours!
We took out the enemy commander!
Our foes have drawn first blood!
